objective: Select the next measured workstream after closing the broader filelist shape-sweep timing public-pack externalization boundary.

decision.reason: The accepted broader shape-sweep timing result is still single-run evidence for the two reviewed filelist-derived targets at 64x1 and 1x64. The narrow next step is repeat-median timing for the same four target/shape pairs before broadening the allocation policy, moving toward native Verilator option work, inferring arbitrary RTL dependencies, changing runtime/ABI behavior, adding GEM comparison, or making production-serving claims.

deferred_candidates.reason: The 64x1 and 1x64 timing evidence is still single-run. Policy broadening should wait until the same shapes have repeat-median timing.
A native option boundary is useful, but it would shift toward integration before the latest shape extension has stable timing evidence.
The accepted filelist flows still depend on explicit source closure or known-template closure. Arbitrary dependency inference is a separate non-claim.
Resident/runtime work may mitigate the weak 1x64 repeated-step cases, but it should follow repeat-median confirmation of the same shape pair.
GEM comparison should wait until the scoped hybrid measurement has stable repeat-median timing; the current result is not enough for a fair comparison boundary.
